scheme_name: Children With Special Needs Under Goa Sarva Shiksha Abhivan
other_conditions: The child must be differently-abled or require special needs.
benefits_summary: Provides grants for activities supporting CWSN, including medical assessments, resource rooms, home‑based education, teaching‑learning materials, and training of educators.
documents_required: Plain application detailing the specific individual needs of the child with disabilities
